senses.gloss: गुण- + अयन गुण- + अयन, adj. walking the path of virtue, Bhāg. P. 4, 21, 43.
गुण- + उत्तर गुण- + उत्तर, m. superior virtue, Rām. 5, 2, 4; n. MBh. 3, 13922.

गुण् गुण्, i. 10, गुणय (rather a denomin. derived from the next), Par.
 1. To multiply. गुणित, Multiplied, MBh. 3, 7030; Megh. 109.
 --Comp.

गुण गुण (for गुष् + न, from गुष् in ved. गुष्-प्; cf. पुष् and पुष्-प्), m.
 1. A string, Ragh. 2, 83.
 2. A bow-string, Rām. 3, 33, 16.
 3. A lutestring, Śiś. 4, 57.
 4. Time; दशगुणास्, Ten times, Man. 2, 85; in this signification it is almost always the latter part of a comp. adj. and preceded by numerals, e. g. अष्टगुण, i. e. अष्टन्-, Eight-fold, Man. 8, 400. द्वि-,
 a. Twofold, double, Cāṇ. 78.
 b. Twice as many, MBh. 3, 14316.
 c. Folded, Yājñ. 1, 232. With an abl., As many times more as are denoted by the numeral, e. g. मूल्यात् पञ्चगुण, i. e. पञ्चन्-, Five times the value, Man. 8, 289; त्वत्तः शतगुणो बले, A hundred times stronger than thou, Rām. 6, 95, 11; also comparat., e. g. द्विगुणतर, Doubled, Pañc. 57, 15.
 5. Species, MBh. 12, 6847.
 6. A subordinate element.
 7. An accompanying dish, Man. 3, 226.
 8. Quality of a subject, Man. 3, 36; 1, 76-78.
 9. The three fundamental qualities: सत्त्व, रजस्, and तमस्, Man. 12, 24.
 10. A good quality, virtue, Man. 9, 141; excellence, Ragh. 3, 30; gain, Pañc. ii. d. 21.
 11. Excess, MBh. 3, 14746.
 12. One of the six expedients in government, Man. 7, 160.
 --Comp.
गुणज्ञ गुण-ज्ञ (vb. ज्ञा), m. A friend of virtue, Bhartṛ. 2, 33.

गुणतस् गुण-तस्, adv.
 1. Concerning good qualities, Man. 11, 185.
 2. Conformably to the three fundamental qualities (see गुण
 9), Bhag. 18, 29.

गुणता गुण + ता, f.
 1. Being subordinate, Bhāg. P. 3, 26, 39 (see गुण
 6).
 2. Excellence, MBh. 3, 11236.

गुणत्व गुण + त्व, n.
 1. The state of being a string, Hit. i. d. 30.
 2. Excellence, Suśr. 1, 184, 10.
गुणन गुण् + अन, n. Exalting, Gīt. 7, 29.

गुणमय गुण + मय, adj., f. यी.
 1. Consisting of virtues, MBh. 1, 6546.
 2. Referable to the three fundamental qualities, MBh. 14, 1327.
गुणवत्ता गुणवत्ता, i. e. गुणवन्त् + ता, [] f. Possession of virtues, MBh. 14, 86.

गुणवन्त् गुण + वन्त्, adj., f. वती.
 1. Possessing good qualities, Rām. 3, 11, 16.
 2. Excellent, Nal. 1, 30.
 --Compar. वत्तर, More excellent, Man. 5, 113.
 --Superl. Most distinguished, Yājñ. 2, 78.
 --Comp.
गुणिता गुणिता, i. e. गुणिन् + ता, f. Possession of virtues, Hit. Pr. 36.

गुणिन् गुणिन्, i. e. गुण + इन्, adj., f. नी.
 1. Possessing qualities or attributes, i. e. being a subject, Bhāg. P. 2, 8, 14.
 2. Possessing good qualities, virtuous, Man. 8, 73.
 3. Knowing the qualities, Mārk. P. 27, 9.
 --Comp.

गुण्ठ् गुण्ठ्, i. 10, Par.
 1. To cover, MBh. 7, 2734.
 2. To ensnare, 6, 819.
 --With the prep. अव अव, To cover, Man. 4, 49.
गुण्ठन गुण्ठ् + अन, n. Covering, Prab. 30, 17 (v. r.)

† गुण्ड् गुण्ड्, i. 10, Par.
 1. To cover.
 2. To pound.
 3. To preserve.
गुण्डन गुण्ड् + अन, n. = गुण्ठन, Prab. 30, 17.
गुण- + ग्राम गुण- + ग्राम, m. a multitude of good qualities, Bhartṛ. 3, 23.
गुण- + ग्राहिन् गुण- + ग्राहिन्, m. acknowledging another's virtues, Lass. 34, 7.
गुण--चक्र- + प्रचोदिन् गुण--चक्र- + प्रचोदिन्, adj. driving the wheel, i. e. possessed of all virtues, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1155.
गुण-अ- + लाभ गुण-अ- + लाभ, m. the not taking effect, Suśr. 1, 131, 5.
गुण- + लुब्ध गुण- + लुब्ध, adj., f. धा, loving excellent qualities, Hit. iv. d. 97.
गुण- + वर्तिन् गुण- + वर्तिन्, adj. pursuing the path of virtue, Rām. 2, 82, 18.
गुण- + विध गुण- + विध, adj. possessed of the different qualities, MBh. 12, 11466.
गुण-समुदय-अवाप्ति- + विषय गुण-समुदय-अवाप्ति- + विषय, adj., f. या, having as its object the acquirement of a multitude of good qualities, [] Hit. i. d. 174, M.M.
गुण- + शील गुण- + शील, adj. virtuous, Hit. i. d. 182.
गुण-, धन- + शुल्क गुण-, धन- + शुल्क, विर्य-, adj., f. का, having as its price, i. e. to be purchase by, good qualities, money, prowess, Daśak. in Chr. 190, 24; 191, 1, and Chr. 4, 14.
